content.text: March 29, 2026, 3:00 p.m. ETSpoiler alert! This story includes details from Episodes 1 - 4 of HBO's "DTF St. Louis."This group of friends is more twisted than you thought.Turns out Floyd (David Harbour) knew his wife, Carol (Linda Cardellini), was having an affair with his best friend Clark (Jason Bateman), and he was OK with it. In fact, he was more than OK, considering he watched the two as they engaged with one another.Episode 4 of HBO's "DTF St. Louis" gave audiences a more in-depth look at the twisted trio's dynamic. The episode, which premiered on Sunday, March 23, revealed that Floyd is in debt, a million-dollar life insurance policy is on the line, Carol may have a criminal record that was sealed or expunged and Clark helped Floyd get amphetamines to help with his erectile dysfunction.While Floyd's death continues to remain a mystery, all clues point towards Carol at this point, as detectives Homer (Richard Jenkins) and Plumb (Joy Sunday) race to solve the death.HBO says the show is about a "love triangle between three adults experiencing middle-age malaise that leads to one of them ending up dead.""DTF St. Louis" creator Steven Conrad told People the show was inspired by his own personal experiences, when he began to see people around him "feel emotional desperation and then make bad decisions" in their middle age."I'm in my middle age, and most of my friends are too, and, somehow or another, it's another phase of life where people make terrible decisions," Conrad told the media outlet. "The first one's 14, and no one wants to live through that again. But that same misguided, desperate need to fit in or to find someone to feel safe, it comes back around in middle age, and it can lead to bad decision-making."Here's what to know about when new "DTF St. Louis" episodes release and how to watch them.When do new episodes of 'DTF St. Louis' come out?Episode 5 of "DTF St. Louis" will air on HBO on Sunday, March 29, at 9 p.m. ET / PT and will be available to stream on HBO Max at the same time, with new episodes dropping weekly on Sundays.The season finale is scheduled for Sunday, April 12.How to watch new 'DTF St. Louis' episodesThe seven-episode season will air on HBO at 9 p.m. ET / 6 p.m. PT on Sundays and will be available to stream on HBO Max at the same time.Watch 'DTF St. Louis' on HBO Max with SlingNeed a news break? Check out the all-new PLAY hub with puzzles, games and more!'DTF St. Louis' episode schedule'DTF St. Louis' will have seven episodes.
